name: run_harness_test
description: Run a harness with a specific task/prompt and return structured evaluation results. This is a test-oriented wrapper: it runs the harness non-interactively, evaluates the session, and returns both the result and quality metrics.

harness_name.description: Name of the harness template to run (e.g. 'react_single', 'coder_react')

agent_identity.description: Identity name to use for the main agent slot (e.g. 'dante', 'coder')

task.description: The task/prompt to give the agent

max_steps.description: Override max_steps for this test run. Default: 10
